reviews.title: Not Practical
reviews.text:
Paid for one week to check out the main feature: putt reading. In my experience, it gets a D.

1. It is way too slow reading the putt to be used unless you’re almost the only person on the course. 

2. The entire thing hinges on the accuracy of your placing the pin position and your ball position. This is definitely non-trivial and the source of considerable potential error. 

In my experience, I read the green far more accurately and faster. 

Cancelled my subscription.

My advice: sign up for a week and try it out. Don’t commit to a longer period until you see it in action.

reviews.title: Confused and irritated. Refund please! No support!
reviews.text: So I searched the apps for the best golf GPS app I could find I came to golf logic at first with just a simple task of tracking distance on fairway. Everything else just didn’t seem to work right. At least not for me supposed to be able to track my clubs, wasn’t able to do that. The app would freeze up. On various hole would put me on the green putting when I was on my approach so I turned to golf logic tutorials. They must be an older version because a lot of of the information was showing how to use features or how to use that I didn’t have even in the app support. All it is is showing you what features are but not how to use them. I took it out. On the course and wound up not using it because it took too much time on holes probably me I don’t know. I suggest update tutorials that show exactly step-by-step how to use the app

reviews.title: Jacked up the price
reviews.text: I have used GolfLogix for years and never had an issue with the $49.99/year price tag.  The app at that price point no longer offers the same basic yardage finders.  Now it’s just tee to green or pay for ‘premium’ to have more precise yardages on a hole.  It’s become a fancy score card if you subscribe to Plus.  I’ve cancelled my subscription and will simply use the free service offered by the USGA.  Thanks for the memories GolfLogix.  It was great while it lasted.

reviews.title: Customer service is useless
reviews.text: This experience was an absolute joke. I stopped using your product within a week of subscribing because it was that bad. Customer service was completely worthless, no help, no solutions, no effort, just a total waste of time. Honestly, I’ve had better run organizations at a putt-putt course. At least putt-putt sets the expectation that it’s cheap, chaotic, and a little broken. Your company charges like a serious business and delivers less professionalism than a windmill obstacle and a faded scorecard. I would not recommend this to anyone.

I want to add what stokes I had on each hole such as putts, chips, bunkers etc.This was possible before I the app was an update. Once in premium you cannot go back. I can get yardage to front middle and back of green. Too confusing to deal with on the course.

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I purchased a monthly subscription from the Apple Store using my Apple account and downloaded it to my iPhone.  I tried to use the app for a round of golf.  I had entered all my clubs and distances and the app worked until halfway through my round.   At that point it started making me Demeter all my clubs but the app wouldn’t save them so it became an endless loop of trying to renter the clubs I wanted to use for the round. In addition the app stopped recording the scores I entered. In short, using this app became a horrible time consuming distraction and really degraded enjoying the round.  The straw that broke the camels back was the fact that the app kept confusing adjacent fairways and couldn’t determine where I was in the course.  I submitted a support request asking to cancel the subscription and I received a snotty note that they don’t issue refunds and that I had to go through Apple.   Believe me I will. I do not recommend this app to anyone.  In my opinion , it is a sub standard app with poor functionality and terrible customer service. I believe there are better apps on the App Store which are more affordable.

reviews.title: Long time user - no more. Lost me with the update.
reviews.text: The update ruined this app that I’ve used for 10+ years. I tried to keep using it but I just can’t anymore. Too many other better options. A real shame.

reviews.title: A once great app - ruined
reviews.text:
I have used this app for years, loved it. And then the upgrade happened. Features removed. Vague promises of their return. Constant ‘upgrades’ but yet zero progress on returning these features. 
18Birdies is a few $$ more, but has much better features and value. I tried contacting the developer - they have stopped responding I guess they can’t handle constructive feedback from customers. 
Such a shame.
